title: Define plugin marketplace, update, package cache, and install source boundaries
description: AstrBot plugin routes and updater separate market sources, MD5/cache validation, package download/unzip, compatibility checks, install/update/uninstall, and readme/changelog serving. Rust has loader and dependency boundaries, but not marketplace/update source boundaries yet.

files.change: Separate remote registry source/cache/package metadata from plugin loader lifecycle.
Model install/update/uninstall plans without performing side effects in web routes.
Keep dashboard plugin market DTOs separate from loader internals.

criteria: Plugin market source/cache logic is not embedded in dashboard routes.
Install/update planning is independent from dynamic plugin loading.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-plugin && cargo test -p astrbot-web && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
